title: Multiple positive bound states for NLS equations on noncompact metric graphs with potential
summary: In this paper, we establish the existence of geometrically distinct bound states for the subcritical Nonlinear Schrödinger (NLS) equation on a noncompact metric graph, provided that the mass is sufficiently large. By bound states we mean critical points of the NLS energy functional constrained to the manifold of fixed $L^2$-norm. We demonstrate that the NLS equation admits at least as many positive bound states as the number of bounded edges of the graph.
